payload.title: Stop needing a hand-made PR to record each deploy
payload.description: Each deploy today seds the package key into infra/lab/template.yaml and deployed-template.snapshot.json, then merges a snapshot PR so check_lab_template.py --live matches and main reaches develop. The pipeline must not depend on that. Options: make the package key a parameter, or have the workflow open the PR. Decide, and also carry main back to develop automatically.
